_meta.datasheet_section: Figure 5-1 (DRV Package 6-Pin WSON Top View) + Table 5-1 (Pin Functions)
_meta.notes: Two package variants in datasheet: WSON-6 (DRV, used here) and DSBGA-6 (YBG). This pinspec is for the DRV (WSON) variant only. [height_max_mm: SNOSD82D DRV0006B outline: WSON 0.8 mm max height] [temp] DS 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: TA −55…150 °C

pins.name: SCL
pins.note: Serial clock (I²C). Datasheet Table 5-1 type=I. [max_v: SNOSD82D §6.1 Abs Max SCL, SDA, ALERT, ADD0 -0.3..6 V (independent of V+; §6.3 VI/O 0..5.5 V)]

pins.name: ALERT
pins.note: Over-temperature alert / data-ready signal. Open-drain — requires pullup. [connect rule: SNOSD82D §8.2.1: 'The ALERT pin can be left floating or connected to ground when not in use'] [max_v: SNOSD82D §6.1 Abs Max SCL, SDA, ALERT, ADD0 -0.3..6 V (independent of V+; §6.3 VI/O 0..5.5 V); open_drain: Table 5-1 ALERT open-drain output, requires pullup]

pins.name: ADD0
pins.note: Address select. Connect to GND, V+, SDA, or SCL to pick I²C addr 0x48-0x4B. [connect rule: SNOSD82D Table 5-1: ADD0 'Connect to GND, V+, SDA, or SCL'] [max_v: SNOSD82D §6.1 Abs Max SCL, SDA, ALERT, ADD0 -0.3..6 V (independent of V+; §6.3 VI/O 0..5.5 V)]

pins.name: V+
pins.note: Supply voltage. Datasheet §6 Power Supply: 1.8 V to 5.5 V over -55 to +150 °C (1.7 V minimum allowed for -55 to +70 °C only). Typical 3.3 V. [connect rule: SNOSD82D Table 5-1: supply voltage]

pins.name: SDA
pins.note: Serial data, open-drain bidirectional. Requires pullup. [connect rule: SNOSD82D Table 5-1: SDA requires a pullup resistor] [max_v: SNOSD82D §6.1 Abs Max SCL, SDA, ALERT, ADD0 -0.3..6 V (independent of V+; §6.3 VI/O 0..5.5 V); open_drain: Table 5-1 SDA open-drain output, requires pullup]

pins.name: EP
pins.note: Exposed thermal pad — connect to GND for thermal dissipation. [connect rule: SNOSD82D §8.2.x / layout: thermal pad not connected to device ground, TI recommends leaving it unsoldered; if soldered 'it must be left floating or grounded']
